description: This file defines a PHP class 'Handling' in the OpenCart admin extension, specifically for managing the 'handling' total fee in the order process. It provides methods to display the handling settings page and save configuration changes.

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: A controller class in the OpenCart admin module for managing handling total fee settings, including display and save functionality.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and renders the handling total fee configuration page in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves the handling total fee configuration submitted via POST, with permission validation.
